contracts.docstring: Freeze complete selected titles/bodies and bounded claim attribution in one snapshot, without creating a source or validating a claim.
Return exact ranked text with its observed claim state and provenance; stored confidence and review presence never imply scientific validity or current review.
Owner and agent similarity results carry the observed claim's status, kind and attribution without promoting declared confidence into validation.
Supply a controlled exact text window so the test measures API provenance rather than encoder quality.
Return one complete corpus chunk while leaving all finding metadata to the production projection.
Late text, status, matching rows or authority changes cannot disclose a stale semantic receipt or its previous attribution.
Model only the intervening commit/withdrawal, not the actual semantic ranking quality.
Change one observed precondition after admission but before the route discloses results.
A real receipt-transaction failure returns HTTP failure with no source; retrying the same intent after recovery commits exactly one source and receipt.
Two versions of one URL retain distinct hashes and exact original quotes; an owner sees the older superseded claim as captured history, not current web evidence.
Change only the external document bytes while production HTTP authorization and SQLite persistence stay real.
Prepare retrieval through its original broker, with distinct operation/output identities when validating multiple source revisions.
Use the MCP SDK on the original broker pipes with an explicit operation identity, without a secondary launcher.
Keep one real index directory across two source revisions, prove current semantic/read results and retain original physical closure.
Require current source and semantic owners, never interpret a missing match as proof of absence.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. No frontend changes in this delivery; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
